subject: CloudScale: unexpected Jun–Jul usage — reconciliation & settlement options
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudscale.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Jun–Jul usage spike — need reconciliation

Hi Marcus / Naomi,

We're trying to close our month and noticed a large unexpected usage spike on our Jun–Jul invoices that wasn't forecasted in our commit. Attached is the CSV export from our billing dashboard (usage_report_Jun-Jul-2026.csv). It shows a ~420k inference-hour delta compared to the committed baseline for Q3.

Can you help reconcile where that came from? If it's on our side we can plan for a top-up; if there's been double-counting or an instrumentation issue, we need to correct the invoice before we close our books. Budget team is asking for a clear explanation and a one-time settlement option by EOD Monday.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Elena Morales
Director of Platform Engineering | CloudScale
elena@cloudscale.io
Attachment: usage_report_Jun-Jul-2026.csv (CSV, 38 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@cloudscale.io>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Jun–Jul usage spike — need reconciliation

Laura / Ben — looping you in to help reconcile and propose options.

Quick read: Elena attached a CSV showing ~420k extra inference hours across June and July; they were on a 1.2M-hr commit for the quarter. Initial suspicion: a model rollout they ran in late June may have used a larger context length and bypassed prefix caching for a short window. Naomi, can you pull runtime logs for that period?

Options we should consider (pick 1):
- One-time invoice for the overage (approx $45k at current rates), or
- Apply an amortized credit across their next 2 invoices if we confirm partial double-counting, or
- Offer a commit amendment (increase commit for remainder of term + 15% credit on the one-time amount) to avoid invoice friction.

Laura: can you run a reconciled number from billing (attach reconciled-usage-summary-CLD5421.pdf) so we have an apples-to-apples figure? Ben: if we go with commit amendment, what approval do we need from pricing?

I'll schedule a 30-min call with Elena for Monday 1pm PT unless you prefer earlier.

On Thu, 20 Aug 2026 at 10:15 AM Elena Morales <elena@cloudscale.io> wrote:
> We're trying to close our month and noticed a large unexpected usage spike on our Jun–Jul invoices...

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0118
Attachments: usage_report_Jun-Jul-2026.csv (as provided by customer)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Reconciled numbers + recommended settlement path (CLD-5421)

Marcus / team — ran the reconciliation against billing and runtime logs. Summary attached as reconciled-usage-summary-CLD5421.pdf. Key points: 
- Reconciled overage: 418,750 inference-hours (Jun 01–Jul 31)
- Gross overage charge at list: $47,062.50
- After applied reserved-commit discount and volume band triggers: $44,250.
- Root cause: combination of an experimental rollout (higher seq_len) and a short-lived mis-tagged cluster that bypassed prefix caching for ~36 hours (naomi confirmed logs).

Options and recommendation:
1) One-time invoice for $44,250 (clear, immediate) — requires PO or payment within 30 days.
2) Split the amount: $29,000 invoice + $15,250 credit applied across next two invoices (helps their budget cadence).
3) Commit amendment: increase quarterly commit by 35% for the remainder of the term in exchange for a 15% reduction on the overage ($37,612.50 effective). This requires sales/GM approval for the credit but avoids a large near-term invoice.

For any path other than #1, finance needs an exec approval email trail. If we go #3 we'll prepare an MOM amendment (DocuSign link suggested).

Action items: Naomi to post logs (done); Ben to run pricing margin on option #3; Marcus to confirm customer preference on Monday call.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: reconciled-usage-summary-CLD5421.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, billing@cloudscale.io
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Jun–Jul usage spike — reconciliation & settlement options

Elena — thanks again for the data and for taking the time on the call earlier. Quick recap and our proposed settlement paths based on reconciliation: 

- Reconciled overage: 418,750 inference-hours (confirmed)
- Option A (straight invoice): $44,250 one-time invoice due Net30 (we have the invoice ready: proposed-settlement-invoice-45000.pdf; final precise amount per payment flow).
- Option B (split): $29,000 billed now + $15,250 credit applied over next two invoices (helps CloudScale's month-end cadence).
- Option C (commit amendment): Redwood will add a 35% supplemental commit for the remaining term and apply a 15% reduction on the overage, netting $37,612.50. This requires a short amendment (DocuSign) and signoff from your procurement.

Please indicate which option you'd prefer by EOD Wednesday so we can either issue the invoice or draft the amendment. If helpful, we can prepare the DocuSign draft for option C ahead of time.

If you confirm option A or B, please send PO/billing contact (or have billing@cloudscale.io confirm). I'll mark finance and billing ops to push the invoice immediately if you pick A.

On Sat, 22 Aug 2026 at 08:40 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus / team — ran the reconciliation against billing and runtime logs...

Thanks — happy to discuss on the call.
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Attachment: reconciled-usage-summary-CLD5421.pdf (attached by finance)
Attachment: proposed-settlement-invoice-45000.pdf (draft invoice stub)
